cntt_page_meta_desc: Faculty of Information Technology - University of Science, VNU-HCM
cntt_intro_p1: The Faculty of Information Technology, University of Science (Vietnam National University, Ho Chi Minh City) is one of the leading faculties in Computer Science and Information Technology in Vietnam. Founded in 1995, the Faculty is not only one of the first undergraduate institutions in Vietnam in this field, but also one of the largest in terms of student enrollment and teaching staff. It is among the most competitive faculties for admission in the country, accepting only high-scoring candidates from national university entrance exams and VNU-HCM assessments, as well as attracting talents who have won medals or awards in national and international programming or mathematics competitions. The Faculty has over 100 full-time faculty members and many visiting professors from renowned universities in Vietnam and abroad.
cntt_intro_p2: Currently, the Faculty trains over 5,000 students at undergraduate, master's, and doctoral levels, covering programs in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Information Technology, and Artificial Intelligence. The Faculty offers diverse undergraduate programs including full-time programs in Vietnamese, English, and French, as well as talented student, high-quality, and distance learning programs.
cntt_intro_partnerships: The Faculty has cooperation and student exchange programs with renowned institutions such as the National Institute of Informatics (NII, Japan), Japan Advanced Institute of Science and Technology (JAIST, Japan), National University of Singapore (NUS), Portland State University (PSU, USA), University of Memphis (UM, USA), and University Claude Bernard Lyon 1 (UCBL1, France),...
cntt_mission_p1: To provide world-class teaching and learning experiences for undergraduate and graduate programs in computer science and information technology.
cntt_mission_p2: To train students and learners to become IT solution developers or professional, successful, self-determined, ethical leaders capable of applying knowledge and skills to improve society.
cntt_vision_p1: To become a world-class institution in computer science and information technology, offering excellent programs and teaching/learning experiences focused on innovating and developing high-quality solutions based on computing and IT to contribute to social development.
cntt_area_kt_p1: Provides students with the highest level of knowledge and necessary skills to build integrated applications with intelligent processing capabilities, applicable in education, training, socio-economics, science and technology, natural resource and environmental management, security...
cntt_area_kt_p2: Knowledge includes foundations of knowledge-based systems, human-computer interaction systems, natural language processing, pattern recognition, image processing...
cntt_area_cs_p1: Provides students with the highest level of knowledge and necessary skills to build integrated applications with intelligent processing capabilities, applicable in education, training, socio-economics, science and technology, natural resource and environmental management...
cntt_area_cs_p2: Knowledge includes foundations of knowledge-based systems, human-computer interaction systems, pattern recognition, image processing...
cntt_area_se_p1: Provides comprehensive knowledge in installation, management, and maintenance of projects, enabling students to design and implement high-quality software products.
cntt_area_se_p2: Graduates of this major will be able to analyze, design, and manage software projects at an intermediate to advanced level.
cntt_area_is_p1: Provides students with the knowledge needed to install and develop information system projects in economic management, office management, and data management.
cntt_area_is_p2: Focuses on technologies applied in information systems such as data modeling, database design approaches, information system analysis and design methods, and distributed information systems...
cntt_area_network_p1: Provides knowledge in wide-area network communications, local area networks, and distributed information systems.
cntt_area_network_p2: Research areas: Computer security and secure software development; DevOps; Distributed systems software development; Cloud system deployment and administration.
cntt_area_cv_p1: Aims to train graduates and engineers specializing in digital image processing, digital video processing, and robotic control software design.
cntt_area_cv_p2: Research directions: Content-based image and video retrieval; Bioinformatics; Character recognition in images and videos; Human action recognition; Human face and emotion simulation; Robot vision; Design automation in architecture and construction.
